title: Concept: Card number carried in a hidden field
description: A hidden input whose value is a full card number in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The PAN sits in the page source where extensions, caches and screenshots can read it, which puts the card in scope even though the flow only needed the last four digits.
applicability: Deployments that render a hidden input whose value is a full card number into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The PAN sits in the page source where extensions, caches and screenshots can read it, which puts the card in scope even though the flow only needed the last four digits.
